expected_level_description: You can: - understand and work with colleagues to apply core techniques for analysis and insight - present clear insights that colleagues can understand and use

skill: Quality assurance of data and analysis

skill: Understanding analysis across the product life cycle
expected_level_description: You can: - describe the importance of performance measures, their relation to business objectives and how they vary at different stages of the product life cycle
You can: - show an awareness that everything we do is focused on the user of the product or service
You can: - show an awareness of ethical and operational constraints
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
